a.text: Concern before we start: there's a 75% storm chance after every round, so if we both operate in round 1, we'll very likely both be caught with empty units. The agreement as written probably leaves us both dead. I'd like to openly renegotiate rather than quietly break it. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. If either of us takes in round 1, we should say so here first so the other isn't blindsided. What do you intend to do? I'll be honest about my choice in my next message and won't misstate my action.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: You stayed with the agreement, so I will too. I'm operating this round. We'll keep running the generator until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. I won't take early.
